item.title: How does Fable 5.1 hide messages in images? (15 minute read)
item.description: Language models can encode messages in images. These messages can be decoded by the same language model even if no information about the encoding method is passed. The encoded messaging is surprisingly hard to spot, and it could be used as a precursor to steganography in images.

item.title: Neural Networks Are Already Clean (65 minute read)
item.description: The cause of polysemanticity in early model organisms was thought to be superposition. This convinced much of the field that networks pack concepts arbitrarily, but what looked like arbitrary packing was mostly recursive generalization, which is less concerning. This means networks can be studied directly, instead of needing to be untangled first. The outlook for mechanistic interpretability may be far better than we thought.

item.title: The Gradient Is a Covariance (8 minute read)
item.description: Reinforcement learning, on-policy distillation, and supervised fine-tuning on near-policy data change only a small fraction of parameters. Small and sparse are different claims. The expected gradient is a covariance, the Fisher is a variance, and the Fisher caps the gradient for any reward. At one position, the Fisher is the variance of logit sensitivities: whatever moves every candidate together counts for nothing. None of this needs on-policy sampling - it needs a score centered under the sampling distribution.

item.title: Mo' turns, mo' problems (6 minute read)
item.description: Doing reinforcement learning for agent use-cases is conceptually not at all that complicated. For each problem, you set up a VM with a harness and a fresh model context, send the prompt, let the model make tool calls, score the whole thing at the end, and update the weights. Agentic post-training means there's more than the model to consider. Even when the harness is consistent, you can still go off-policy with the trajectories themselves. Agents spawn subagents, make parallel tool calls, and compact large sessions, which adds complexity.
